purpose: User-authorized diagnosis of failed Stage 1 gradients, without revising its failed gate

fixture.noise_recovery: Reconstruct using original seeded XPU initialization/order; require recorded digest equality, then persist the exact tensors. The original log retained a hash, not noise tensors.
fixture.data: case30 v4, identical cached history/calendar/target, masks, train-derived scales, seed42 backbone checkpoint and saved normalizer
fixture.gradient: Unclipped loss gradient at identical initial parameters; no optimizer or scheduler updates

reference.policy: Cast the original fp32 adapter, frozen backbone, floating buffers, cached inputs, calendar, graph attributes, noise, target and scales to fp64; preserve integer indices and Boolean masks. Cached history embeddings are the same recorded fp32 values promoted to double, not recomputed embeddings.
reference.loss: Same all-pairs fair ES and balance weighting; sqrt(observed dimension), ES reductions and squared balance residual reduction evaluated in fp64. This corrects the existing integer sqrt's default fp32 result only in this diagnostic.

comparisons.order: CPU reference, fp32 ON, fp32 OFF 1..5, then conditional policies in listed order
comparisons.reinitialization: Each evaluation clones the same fixture parameters and uses identical recorded noise, without consuming new noise
comparisons.cadence: Save outputs, every trainable parameter gradient and comparison metrics after each evaluation

metrics.near_zero_policy: If either vector norm is <= floor, cosine is null and cannot pass; norm ratio is null if reference norm is <= floor. Absolute difference norm is always reported. No epsilon can turn an undefined cosine into a pass.
forward: Vm mean/max/p95 absolute delta in p.u.
joint mean/max/p95 absolute delta in mixed physical units
metrics.forward_role: Descriptive diagnostic, no unrequested output gate
metrics.ON_closer: Compare ON cosine to OFF min/median/max separately for each group; report norm-ratio error from one and normalized difference norm as additional evidence. Mixed directions must not be called uniformly closer.

decision.justification: Thresholds supplied by the user before this diagnostic
decision.usable: Every group in all six baseline fp32 evaluations has cosine >=0.99: candidate for OFF under the user's separate epoch-level acceptance gate; this single-batch experiment itself supplies no epoch acceptance evidence
decision.unreliable: Any group in either mode has cosine <0.95: current fp32 gradient is unreliable on this fixture; run the conditional loss/head fp64 tests and record a methods note before speedup work
decision.intermediate: Any unresolved or [0.95,0.99) group without a <0.95 group: inconclusive; hold Stage 2
decision.epoch_gate_if_usable: Use matching v4 seed42/1/2 per-epoch min/max selection ES envelopes, not final-score spreads. Check stopping epoch within one only where early stopping occurred; budget stops are censored. Require finite metrics. A new acceptance protocol and passing evidence are required before a stage merge.

conditional_details.repeats: Each policy: ON once, OFF five times, same fixture and CPU reference
conditional_details.loss64: Backbone, adapter and physics remain fp32; promote joint, target, scales and final per-bus P/Q residuals before fair ES, square/mean balance and weighted loss accumulation
conditional_details.heads64: Only bus_head, gen_head, backbone.mlp_bus and backbone.mlp_gen parameters/operations and their input activations are fp64; cast each module output back to fp32 before innovation/conditioning, bounds or physics. Frozen backbone readouts remain frozen; trainable head gradients are double. Other parameters/operations/loss are fp32.
conditional_details.heads_loss64: Composition of the two specified policies
conditional_details.evaluation: Report the same five-group metrics and supplied cosine categories; no production precision adoption from one batch

job.device_convention: ZE_FLAT_DEVICE_HIERARCHY=FLAT, ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0; assert exactly one visible XPU tile
job.accounting: One reserved 20-minute node allocation; also record actual full job/worker cost and per-evaluation times, including CPU reference. Diagnostic timings include cold-start and serialization overhead, not production speed estimates.
stop_conditions: unexpected missing adapter gradient or nonzero frozen-backbone gradient
job.guard_behavior: Save atomic results after every evaluation; parent terminates the worker process group on timeout; record incomplete diagnosis and launch no retry
job.environment: Existing Aurora frameworks/vendor torch and existing venv; no installation or upgrades

limitations: One initial case30 origin, not a training trajectory or production acceptance
CPU fp64 is a higher-precision numerical reference, not an analytic exact gradient
ON once cannot estimate ON repeat variability
FP64 selective heads do not promote message passing or physics
No Stage 2 compute in this diagnostic allocation
